message:
Hi Shaheer
Hi,

We are a small nonprofit organization (<http://themidasproject.com|themidasproject.com>) starting a YouTube channel and looking for a thumbnail for our first video. Ideally we'd like to get this by the start of next week (monday or tuesday). If you can help, I can share our video, a google doc with thumbnail ideas/guidance, and even one thumbnail I tried making myself. We'd prefer no AI assets in the thumbnail (although minor AI-assited edits such as generative fill in photoshop are probably okay). Can you help?

Hi tyler, I Believe yes I can help
let's discuss more about it whenever you're available.

you can share the details for your channel and content as well and the previous thumbnail you've tried making by yourself.

Thumbnail thoughts here: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/11e_HuK0B5XMeRTR09OBmKTtQnL78Gj2pkrxhpiLREbg/edit?usp=sharing>

Current version of the video is here: <https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kLqmJlNzQGPXbe_vjqCicIyllrd-WxON/view?usp=sharing>

The thumbnail I tried making is attached, I think it is only okay.
yes things can be improved and like the thumbnail will be done within 24-48hrs sounds good?
could you also share any competitor or designs that you like, and also if you want me to follow a brand guideline you can share that as well.
also send me a title in your mind for the video or I can also share my title Variations as well alongside your title so we can A/B Test as well.

One Question though as I don't mind working on Hourly, Sometimes it's hard to concentrate to work while Looking along side the clock, do you mind on moving to a milestone based if you're okay with that.

let me know your thougths so we can get started on it asap.
Okay I modified the offer!

> could you also share any competitor or designs that you like, and also if you want me to follow a brand guideline you can share that as well.

All my thoughts here are in the google doc if that works for you?
let me Quickly go through it tyler

I Believe I have all the details in terms of video, ideas, examples and your thoughts too.

the last thing, Would I have to Extract your image from the video itself or you have some picture of your headshots?

> also send me a title in your mind for the video or I can also share my title Variations as well alongside your title so we can A/B Test as well.

We are planning on A/B testing the following three titles:

How we traced a bot-run newsroom back to OpenAI’s super PAC.
We caught OpenAI’s super PAC funding a bot-run newsroom.
The news site using AI bots as reporters.
Yeah I would take my image from the video itself if that's okay!

we can do that but I mostly prefer images taken seperately as they're better In Quality and we have more images to play with with different poses,

But If not possible I Can also take images from the video itself and if you don't like it then we can change it.
Okay awesome, thank you! We could potentially do more headshot-style images for future videos
but for now lifting screenshots from this one should be good

also one more thing is that I Do use Ai not for the asset creation but maybe ot generate some elements, change somethings in photos using Generative Ai or other Ai's but by making sure that everything looks natural and not look like made by Ai.

I though to be transparent about the section of Ai I use with you.
Sure

> maybe ot generate some elements, change somethings in photos using Generative Ai or other Ai's but by making sure that everything looks natural

I would rather you not do any of these
I think the extent of what we're okay with in terms of AI editing are things like using photoshop's generative fill to remove a distracting prop from the background
But we'd rather have no newly generated assets or wholesale editing of the photograph
Can I show you some of the images to have your confidence? like before/after?
if you don't want it we won't do it then
Yeah I'm okay with you sharing. I'm curious how you're doing it. If it's uploading images to ChatGPT/Gemini/Midjourney/etc. and asking it to change things, we'd probably want to veto it

Sorry about that -- we are an AI industry watchdog group and many of our supporters have concerns about the impact that AI has on artists for example, so we try to avoid using AI-generated assets or using AI tools for coarse editing of an entire photo
first thing first I Will not use Ai will make sure to take or create original assets in photoshop.
Yeah sadly I think these are examples of the AI doing wholesale content generation (even based on existing photos) so this is the sort of thing we'd rather not happen. Hope this works for you!

Understood, Tyler. I won't be using AI for wholesale content generation. All the assets will be created manually in Photoshop. The only AI involved will be minimal use of Photoshop's Generative Fill for small touch-ups, not for generating full assets. Let me know if that works for you.
Great, that works. Thank you!
Perfect, thank you Tyler! I'll get started and will provide the thumbnail within 48hrs ... Sounds good

Hey Tyler, Hope you're Doing well. Quick heads up:

The concept's all done; now it's just a matter of implementing everything. One thing though: I've come down with a pretty high fever and I'm being admitted for an IV drip. If I get discharged today, I'll send you the final thumbnail variation by tonight, otherwise tomorrow for sure.

And once that's done, if you'd like any revisions, just let me know. Happy to keep refining it until you're fully satisfied with the result.

Best, Shaheer

Hey tyler, Hope you're doing well, made these two Concepts also have a sillouhette version in mind will be sharing it shortly. till then you have share your thoughts on these and if any Revisions is Required I'm happy to assist.

Hi Tyler, It's been a while Since I've heard from you regarding your thoughts on the existing thumbnail design or any new thumbnail details, so I thought to send you a follow-up message if you missed the message.
Looking forward to hear from you soon.

best, Shaheer

HI Shaheer,

So sorry for the late reply. Thank you for making these! We ended up going with another thumbnail for the video but I appreciate your help. Will pay now and add a bonus due to the late payment from our end.

Thanks so much for your help!

Tyler
